name: Kodama Ichika
source:
As a member of the Kendo Team, Ichika is subject to [url=/c98548]Gin[/url] and [url=/c98381]Tomoko[/url]'s seemingly inhuman sword training. Since she enjoys video games, she hangs out at the arcade on days she doesn't have team practice. She adores her older sister [url=/c98614]Hajime[/url].

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
